stem:
Kiara tests two destarched leaves for starch with iodine after removing green colour. Leaf P had green and pale non-green patches and stayed in sunlight. Leaf Q was all green and stayed in a dark cupboard.

Answer both parts.

parts.text: Where should the blue-black starch result appear?

options.text: Only in the green patches of Leaf P.
In both the green and non-green patches of Leaf P.
In Leaf Q as well as in the green patches of Leaf P.
Only in the non-green patches of Leaf P.

parts.text: Give one reason for your choice.

part_answers.answer: Starch forms where green tissue received sunlight, so only the green patches of Leaf P should turn blue-black.

teacher.key_rationale: Starch appears in green sunlit tissue only. Including non-green patches, the dark leaf, or only non-green patches misses chlorophyll and light requirements.
